subject: Acme — Evaluation kickoff & next steps
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Acme — Evaluation kickoff & next steps

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier — great to hear more about Acme's search and summarization use cases. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can get the evaluation moving: 

Summary from discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce time-to-answer for support agents and summarize multi-thread customer issues.
- Key success criteria: 1) 10–15% reduction in avg handle time, 2) >= 85% summary accuracy on the selected prompt set, 3) latency below 300ms p50 for single-turn queries.
- Data constraints: no customer PII in prompts; integration via secure API; SOC 2 required.

Proposed next steps:
1) Evaluation kickoff (60–90m): technical deep dive + run-of-show for trial plan, confirm prompt set and eval metrics.
2) Provide trial access (2–4 weeks) with pre-configured tests and a small prompt/eval harness.
3) Weekly check-ins and a final readout with numbers and recommended model/configs.

We'd like to schedule the kickoff week of Feb 22. A few windows that work on our side (PT):
- Wed Feb 24, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu Feb 25, 14:00–15:30 PT
- Fri Feb 26, 09:00–10:00 PT

I've attached a brief evaluation proposal and a sample prompt set to give you a sense of the tests we'll run. Please let us know which slot works or propose alternatives. Also, if you want your security or infra lead on the kickoff, happy to include Neha from our security/compliance team on the call — she can address SOC 2 and data handling questions.

Attachments: acme-eval-proposal.pdf, acme-sample-prompt-set.csv

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0134

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme — Evaluation kickoff & next steps

Thanks, Connor — helpful recap. Wed/Thu look best for us. Proposed attendees: myself (Product), Tom Rivera (Eng manager), and I'll loop in security if needed.

We can do Thu Feb 25 at 14:00 PT. Please include Neha from your security team so we can cover SOC 2 scoping up front.

Quick Q: will the evaluation environment require us to upload any sample logs, or can we drive tests via API with synthetic prompt sets?

Samantha Lee
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
samantha.lee@acme.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme — Evaluation kickoff & next steps

Samantha — perfect, Thu Feb 25 at 14:00 PT works. I sent a calendar invite (link below) — please accept when you get a sec.

Short answers to your question: you can do either. For speed we typically recommend driving the first round via API with a synthetic prompt set (we'll provide the harness). If you want to validate on real logs, we can coordinate a secure S3 transfer or use your VPC private deployment path — Neha can scope the options on the call.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-eval-kickoff-20260225
Drive folder (trial plan & shared docs): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BxxAcmeEvalPlan

I've attached a short mutual action plan that lays out responsibilities and timelines; Marissa will own onboarding and the eval runbook.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.docx

See you on Thu — Connor

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>

Subject: Acme kickoff prep — Thu 2/25 14:00 PT

Marissa — quick internal note to prep for the kickoff tomorrow:

Agenda (60–75 min):
- 0–10m: Intros & success criteria alignment (Samantha, Tom)
- 10–30m: Technical architecture and integration options (Neha + Connor)
- 30–55m: Prompt set walk-through and live run of 10 sample prompts (Marissa)
- 55–65m: Evaluation plan, timelines, and next steps

Prep items:
- Bring the sample evaluation harness and the first 25 prompts from acme-sample-prompt-set.csv.
- Confirm test harness credentials and a short script to run the API calls.
- Be ready to discuss default batching/quant settings for the trial.

I'll own the kickoff invite and follow-up. If you want, drop any additional notes into the Drive folder before the call.

Connor
